newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: NAFTOS TERMINALAS TO PAY 15 LITAS DIVIDEND.
newsitem.headline: NAFTOS TERMINALAS TO PAY 15 LITAS DIVIDEND.

text.p: Lithuania's majority state-owned company Naftos Terminalas said on Friday that it would pay 15.79 million litas in dividends or 15 litas per share.
A company board member Jelena Chernij told Reuters that the dividends were approved at a shareholder meeting.
She also said that the dividends represented 10 percent of the shareholder capital of the company. The share capital is 157.9 million litas.
It earlier reported that it had 57.26 million litas net profit in 1996 versus 48.3 million litas profit in 1995.
